rationale: Review started 2026-11-25T01:20:29Z and ended 2026-11-25T01:25:02Z. All cited held texts were re-hashed (every source_fingerprints file and every evidence record's text_path matched its pinned sha256) and every record's text equals its file slice at char_start:char_end. Read the held original (48 FR 36801) in full: Executive Order 12437 of August 11, 1983, Fuel Use Prohibitions, issued from the White House; the OCR text layer carries no legible presidential signature line, so the signatory is attributed only by date and Federal Register placement under Presidential Documents, and number, date, citation and subject all match the OFR metadata. The order's sole operative sentence is "it is hereby ordered that Executive Order No. 12217 is revoked." The basis OWN_TEXT:EO:12437#690 re-derives exactly that sentence, spent on issue, effective 1983-08-11; I confirmed there is no other command, body, duty, report or term anywhere in the order, so nothing in it could be in force on 2026-10-14. No earlier end is possible, and no revival exists: the cruden number search of held order texts found 0 matches, and the held 42 U.S.C. 8373 note (theophilus-sources) mentions EO 12437 only as the revoker of EO 12217, as the producer says. Both history observations (OFR "Revokes: EO 12217" and the 1989 codification "RevokesEO 12217") record only this order's action on another order; there are no history flags. Status no is supported by held sources only.
